originalProject: EmojiNet — Kno.e.sis Center, Wright State University (Sanjaya Wijeratne, Lakshika Balasuriya, Amit Sheth, Derek Doran)
publication: Wijeratne, S., Balasuriya, L., Sheth, A., & Doran, D. (2017). EmojiNet: An Open Service and API for Emoji Sense Discovery. Proceedings of the International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media (ICWSM 2017), 11(1), 437–446. https://doi.org/10.1609/icwsm.v11i1.14857. Earlier construction paper: arXiv:1610.07710 (SocInfo 2016). Ph.D. dissertation (2018): Wright State CORE Scholar 2227.
provenance: Phase 8.1 incorrectly locked emojinet.org and usc-isi-i2/emojinet — neither is the Wright State EmojiNet project. The original project is hosted at http://emojinet.knoesis.org/ (currently offline). The author-endorsed reproducible public mirror is Kaggle rtatman/emojinet version 1 (2017-11-02), linked from the author's homepage. Identity verified via author attribution, ICWSM 2017 metadata match (2,389 emoji / 12,904 sense labels), and post-download structural verification of emojis.json (SHA-256 5342d56cd4700876ff661c921adc52e6276d8d667a4cadbaa2a05379a468e633). Original bulk URL http://emojinet.knoesis.org/dataset/emojidata.zip is documented on archived dataset.php but is not currently downloadable and has no Internet Archive binary capture.
